headline: Zcash Co-Founder Proposes Reallocating 8% Block Reward to Future Miner Reserve
summary: Zcash co-founder Sean Bowe proposed ending grant funding allocations, seeking to direct the 8% block reward share of new ZEC creation to a dedicated miner reserve.
why: Tokenomics and protocol reward governance proposals alter miner incentives and development funding in proof-of-work crypto networks.
